svg.title: Setup Hermes Agent for WhatsApp: From a WhatsApp command to an automated action
svg.desc: Single-canvas technical architecture poster. Request/response loop: WhatsApp on a phone -> Baileys + bridge.js -> logging + allowlist -> Hermes Agent (SKILL.md) -> Firecrawl -> deterministic scripts -> Google Sheets -> LLM formatting -> reply to WhatsApp. Hosted on Railway with /opt/data (skills, scripts, whatsapp logs). Every major component is a grouped, id-tagged, animation-ready element.
